experiments.title: A pendulum moves its spring-mounted cart
experiments.description: Release a 1 kg pendulum bob from 35° on a 2 kg sliding cart attached to a 20 N/m wall spring. The cart translates while the unactuated hinge rotates. A massless rigid rod joins the pivot to the point mass; its sphere shows position and adds no rotational inertia. The six-second recording uses ideal joints and an undamped spring.

experiments.title: Q192 · Three blocks fall with two springs
experiments.description: Watch three identical blocks after the top thread is cut. The springs retain their hanging-equilibrium stretch at release, so the blocks begin with different accelerations and the springs oscillate as the system falls. The 1 kg blocks, 100 N/m springs, dimensions and 0.8-second interval are illustrative choices. The support marker is a stationary visual reference; no support remains attached.

experiments.title: Two pendulums exchange motion through one spring
experiments.description: Two unequal point-mass bobs hang from fixed hinges on massless rods. A single ideal spring connects the bobs, transferring force and energy as both angles evolve freely. Released at +24° and −12° from downward with zero initial angular velocities; 1 kg and 1.3 kg bobs, 12 N/m spring and all dimensions are explicit illustrative choices, not a quotation from the problem PDF.
